articles.title: Bobbi Althoff takes on viral ‘Hotel Lobby’ trend with Quavo
articles.summary: TikTok has found its latest obsession, and Bobbi Althoff just gave it a very real-world twist. The internet has spent the past few weeks recreating Quavo and Takeoff's iconic "Hotel Lobby" performance with AI, placing celebrities, athletes, fictional characters and even animals into the orange COLORS set made famous by the 2022 performance. Althoff decided to skip the artificial part. She teamed up with Quavo himself. The result was a real-life recreation of the viral format, complete with the unmistakable orange backdrop, the hanging microphone and Althoff's signature expressionless delivery. Instead of watching AI transform two photos into Quavo and Takeoff's performance, viewers got Althoff actually standing in the scene alongside Quavo.

articles.title: Northwestern spent $875 million on a smaller stadium. Opening night explained why
articles.summary: Northwestern did not unveil its new home quietly. The Wildcats opened the $875 million Ryan Field on Friday night against Penn State, turning the first game in their new stadium into a spectacle, and then making the night even more memorable with a 34-13 victory over the Nittany Lions. The new Ryan Field is unlike most major college football stadium projects. Northwestern spent more money than any college program has previously spent on a stadium while intentionally reducing its capacity to 35,000, making it the smallest venue in the Big Ten. The philosophy is clear: fewer seats, closer fans, louder football.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes shares the part of his comeback that NFL fans didn’t see
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes offered a glimpse into that part of his comeback journey during the Chiefs Kingdom Show, explaining just how much work went into his recovery from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season. At one point, Mahomes was spending roughly seven hours a day at the Chiefs' facility working through his rehabilitation. Head coach Andy Reid had previously described how Mahomes was at the facility for hours every day, working alongside assistant athletic trainer Julie Frymyer. That was the part of the comeback that most people never saw. And while Mahomes was spending much of his day rehabbing, his family had to adjust around the process. That is where his wife, Brittany Mahomes, entered the story.
